artists.biography:
Paul Frederic Simon (born October 13, 1941) is a Grammy Award winning American singer-songwriter, poet and guitarist.
Simon's international fame and success began as part of the duo Simon & Garfunkel, launched in 1964 with musical partner Art Garfunkel. Simon wrote most of the pair's songs, including three that reached No. 1 on the U.S. singles charts: "The Sound of Silence", "Mrs. Robinson", and "Bridge Over Troubled Water". The duo split up in 1970 at the height of their popularity, and Simon began a successful solo career, recording three highly acclaimed albums over the next five years. In 1986, he released Graceland, an album inspired by South African township music. Simon also wrote and starred in the film One-Trick Pony (1980) and co-wrote the Broadway musical The Capeman (1998).

perplexity.description:
Seven Psalms is Paul Simon's fifteenth solo studio album, released in May 2023 through Owl Records after a seven-year gap in new material. The seven-track LP was conceived as a continuous listening experience rather than a collection of individual songs, with Simon explaining that the work represents "an argument I'm having with myself about belief or not." Recorded entirely on acoustic instruments and primarily performed by Simon himself, the album incorporates choral arrangements from the British vocal ensemble VOCES8 and features a vocal appearance by Edie Brickell, Simon's wife. The production was handled by Simon alongside Kyle Crusham.

The album's musical foundation draws from folk and acoustic traditions, emphasizing intimate instrumentation and lyrical introspection. The track listing—"The Lord," "Love Is Like a Braid," "My Professional Opinion," "Your Forgiveness," "Trail of Volcanoes," "The Sacred Harp," and "Wait"—suggests thematic explorations of spirituality, relationships, and personal reflection. With a total runtime of approximately 33 minutes, the album's compact length reinforces its intended presentation as a unified artistic statement.

Simon has described the album's genesis as deeply personal, tracing its origins to a vivid dream on January 15, 2019, in which the title came to him fully formed. The work represents a contemplative late-career project that prioritizes artistic vision over commercial considerations, marking a significant artistic statement in Simon's extensive catalog.
